name: Nat
description: The fierce, mute Illuskan leader of the street urchins residing at Trollskull Manor[cite: 2, 3]. Known as the 'General of the Streets,' she commands the domestic intelligence network for the party[cite: 2].
key_facts: She is mute and communicates rapidly using hand signals, which are often translated by Jenks[cite: 2].
She acts as the leader of the urchins, operating alongside Havik since their days at the Golden Horn Gambling Hall[cite: 2].
She was critically burned in the Trollskull Alley fireball blast and her skin sloughed off from the heat, but she survived thanks to Vilis's stabilization and Moriah's medical skins[cite: 2].
Despite her severe injuries, she maintains a gladiatorial spirit, considering her burn scars to be 'armor' and practicing her combat forms on the balcony with her wooden toy sword[cite: 3, 4].
She brokered a neighborhood truce and employment alliance with the rival Appleton boys after they bullied her crew and temporarily stole her wooden sword[cite: 2].
gm_notes: Nat's near-death experience in the fireball attack is a massive emotional anchor for the party[cite: 2]. The Zhentarim specifically targeted her and the other urchins using flying snakes as an asymmetric hostage tactic during the siege of Trollskull Manor due to their physical vulnerability[cite: 4].

name: Jenks
description: A young human boy and aspiring magic-user who lives in the southwest bedroom of Trollskull Manor with his fellow urchins[cite: 3, 4]. He acts as the vocal translator for Nat's sign language[cite: 2].
key_facts: He dreams of being a powerful mage, though his magical abilities are currently limited to failing at casting the Prestidigitation cantrip[cite: 4].
He was deeply frustrated and angered when his toy wand was charred in the Trollskull Alley fireball, blaming the 'Puppet Man' for his inability to stop the destruction[cite: 2].
He found the critical clue linking the fireball to Lord Dagult Neverember by scooping up a dropped gold coin bearing the former Open Lord's profile just before the blast[cite: 2, 4].
He helps maintain and test the mechanical chime-and-rope alarm system rigged from the manor's attic to the front alley to warn the party of intruders[cite: 3, 4].
He offered his personal savings of silver chips to help pay for the manor's security, which prompted the party to sponsor his tuition at Murkledorn's Academy instead[cite: 4].
gm_notes: Jenks is the primary vocal communicator for the children[cite: 2]. His enrollment at Murkledorn's Academy, alongside the Appleton boys, represents the party's long-term investment in the neighborhood's future[cite: 4].

name: Squidly
description: A young tiefling boy who wears an eye patch, completing the trio of urchin informants living at Trollskull Manor[cite: 2]. He is an eager, fiercely protective runner for the party's intelligence network[cite: 3].
key_facts: He ran the party's earliest intelligence-gathering errands, using silver provided by Sudara to research the ghost 'Lif' at the Font of Knowledge[cite: 2].
He was roughed up by the rival Appleton boys, who stole his shoes during a turf dispute[cite: 2].
In the terrifying aftermath of the alley fireball, he armed himself with a jagged shard of glass to protect the manor until Sudara replaced it with a proper small dagger[cite: 2].
gm_notes: Squidly is highly protective of Nat and the manor[cite: 4]. Like Jenks and Nat, his safety was leveraged against the party during Urstul Floxin's siege, forcing the group to account for his vulnerability in combat[cite: 4].
